title: Fate's Twin
next_chapter_hook: When Chen Ji demanded 'Who are you?' in his dream, the blurry figure suddenly pressed closer. The Tianji Record convulsed violently within his Mental Sea, emitting a series of piercing warnings. More eerie still, he found himself unable to discern the figure's features—as if an invisible veil shrouded all crucial information.

text.content: In the deep of night, within the Tianqing Sect Servants' Quarters, Chen Ji's eyes snapped open, cold sweat soaking his back. In the depths of his Mental Sea, the Tianji Record Fragment trembled at an uncanny frequency, golden characters flickering in and out of sight, seemingly conveying some warning. 'He is not the final Chess Player'—these words pierced his heart like a thorn. Cold wind gusted outside the window, stirring the bamboo shadows, while Chen Ji's gaze pierced through the darkness toward that demonic Qi-shrouded firmament in the northern sky.

dialogue.content: The voice of the remnant soul Mo Xiansheng resonated in the Mental Sea, carrying unprecedented gravity: 'Master, this aura... should not appear in this era. The Demonic Path commander commander's Heavenly Fate has resonated with the Tianji Record—an unprecedented phenomenon in ten thousand years. You must be cautious. Once the bond between Fate's twins takes shape, the consequences will be unimaginable.'

text.content: Chen Ji's brow furrowed tightly, his fingers tapping lightly against the bed's edge, his mind already calculating. The Tianji Record's warning, the pull of destiny, and that lingering sense of familiarity—all pointed toward a possibility he had never considered. Slowly, he closed his eyes, his divine sense sinking into the Mental Sea, attempting a deeper communion with the Tianji Record Fragment. Yet just then, a wave of dizziness struck, his consciousness growing hazy.

When he opened his eyes again, the scene before him had completely changed. This was a gray Void, with no sky nor earth, only endless mists churning around. Chen Ji looked down at his own hands—they appeared semi-transparent—a dream, an interdimensional space where divine senses intertwined. And at that moment, a figure emerged slowly from the distant mist, walking toward him.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji scanned his surroundings, alarm bells ringing in his heart yet his expression unchanged. 'What expert dares cause mischief within Chen's Mental Sea?' His voice echoed through the Void, but no one answered. The figure drew nearer, yet the footsteps were eerily light, as if treading on cotton.

text.content: When the figure finally emerged from the mist, Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. The visitor was a young man of similar age, clad in a flowing black robe embroidered with诡异的魔纹, and hanging from his waist was a pitch-black Jade Pendant—its shape startlingly similar to the ancestral Jade Pendant Chen Ji carried. Most shocking of all: the contours of his brow and eyes bore a striking resemblance to Chen Ji himself.

dialogue.content: The young man stopped three zhang away, a meaningful smile playing at his lips, his voice low and magnetic: 'Chen Ji... or perhaps I should address you as brother? After ten thousand years, the Chen bloodline reunites in such an unexpected manner. We share the same roots—why must we destroy each other?' His gaze upon Chen Ji carried an inexplicable, complex sentiment.

choice.prompt: How should Chen Ji respond to this sudden 'kin'?

choices.description: Disguise one's true strength with atrash persona, use words to刺激 the other party into exposing weaknesses, while secretly observing whether this so-called 'same origin' is friend or foe.
choices.visible_cost: May expose one's own special nature
choices.visible_reward: Obtain more information about the other party's identity and intentions
choices.risk_hint: If the other party has malicious intent, may alert the enemy

dialogue.content: Chen Ji sneered, leaning against the illusory barrier with arms crossed, his gaze playful: 'Same origin? A Servant Disciple like me could never aspire to associate with the Demonic Path. As for you, a堂堂 Demonic Path commander, playing tricks to amuse yourself with atrash—what new form of entertainment is this?' His tone was disdainful to the extreme, yet secretly he activated the Tianji Record, attempting to capture the other's Heavenly Fate trajectory.

choices.description: Display moderate interest and confusion, use the identity of a Chen family member as a point of entry, make probing inquiries about the Chen family's secrets from ten thousand years ago and how much the other party knows.
choices.visible_cost: May cause the other party to misjudge one's ignorance
choices.risk_hint: If the act is exposed, may fall into a passive position

dialogue.content: Chen Ji narrowed his eyes slightly, tempering some of his world-weary demeanor, his tone carrying a hint of seriousness: 'The Chen family from ten thousand years ago... What do you know? I was brought to the Tianqing Sect as a child and know nothing of family affairs. If you truly are a descendant of our ancestors, why not speak clearly?' He deliberately revealed a trace of bewilderment,恰到好处地 playing the role of a懵懂 youth ignorant of the past.

choices.description: Directly state the fact that one possesses the Tianji Record Fragment, explore possibilities of cooperation based on mutual benefit, be straightforward without testing.
choices.risk_hint: Exposing the Tianji Record's existence may invite greater crisis

dialogue.content: Chen Ji stared directly into the other's eyes, then suddenly smiled: 'Since both of us can enter this dream realm, we must each have our own relied-upon strengths. I'll lay my cards on the table—I have the Tianji Record Fragment, which can glimpse three hours into the future. Since you claim we're of the same origin, let's be frank: what do you want? And what do I need to pay?' His candor visibly startled the young man.

text.content: Upon hearing this, instead of getting angry, a hint of appreciation flickered in the young man's eyes. He walked forward slowly, and with each step, Chen Ji felt an invisible pressure bearing down on him. The surrounding mist began churning violently, as if responding to something. The jet-black jade pendant at his waist suddenly emitted a faint glow, resonating with the ancestral jade pendant in Chen Ji's embrace.

dialogue.content: 'Interesting.' The young man chuckled lightly. 'As expected of someone the Tianji Record chose, both your courage and temperament are top-notch. My name is Ling Yuan. Ten thousand years ago, a pair of twins from the Chen family was forcibly separated, their bloodline split in two—one branch remained with the humans, your ancestor; the other was taken by the Demonic Path Holy Sect, fused with ancient demonic blood.' He paused, his gaze burning intensely. 'You and I carry the same blood—this is a mark etched by fate, forever impossible to erase.'

text.content: Tidal waves crashed in Chen Ji's heart, yet his expression remained unruffled. The Tianji Record Fragment in his Mental Sea vibrated violently, seemingly transmitting some warning, or perhaps confirming something. He suddenly recalled something Mo Xiansheng once said—'Those chosen by the Tianji Record are destined to have eternal rivals.' Could this person be his destined nemesis? But why from the other's eyes did he see not killing intent, but an inexplicable... intimacy?

Just then, the dream space shuddered violently. Ling Yuan looked up at the void, his brow furrowed: 'Time is running out. Someone outside is interfering with our connection. It's people from the Xuanwu Sect... the one behind them has made a move.' His voice suddenly became urgent. 'Chen Ji, remember my words—the Eye of Heavenly Dao is merely a chess piece, and the one playing the game is about to awaken. If you and I don't unite, we will be eliminated one by one!'

choice.prompt: Faced with Ling Yuan's warning and proposal, Chen Ji must make a decision

choices.description: Agree to cooperate against higher existences, but retain one's own trump cards and independent action rights—ally in name but not in heart.
choices.visible_reward: Gain a powerful helper when facing Heaven's Dao-level adversaries
choices.risk_hint: If the other party has hidden motives, one may be counteracted

dialogue.content: After pondering for a moment, Chen Ji finally nodded: 'Cooperation is acceptable, but I need to know what you have mastered, and who exactly is the one behind the Xuanwu Sect. I dislike making decisions with asymmetric information.' His tone was calm yet left no room for argument. 'Give me a way to contact you. Once I've verified the facts, we can discuss the next steps.'

choices.description: Maintain high vigilance against this sudden 'blood relative', politely decline cooperation under the pretense of needing time for verification, and secretly prepare contingencies.
choices.visible_reward: Don't expose more trump cards, maintain initiative
choices.risk_hint: If the other party is sincere, one may miss an opportunity

dialogue.content: Chen Ji stepped back, creating distance: 'Same origin? Who can say for certain about events ten thousand years ago. Blood relatives can still turn against each other, let alone this虚无缥缈 bloodline connection.' His gaze cooled. 'If you want cooperation, you must show some sincerity. Trying to win my trust with empty words is an insult to Chen Ji.'

text.content: Upon hearing this, Ling Yuan's lips curved into a playful smile: 'You're quite cautious. Very well, cautious people live longer.' He waved his hand, and a strand of jet-black spiritual energy shot toward Chen Ji, forming into a small demonic rune mark that sank into his palm. 'This is the communication mark of the Demonic Holy Sect. You can contact me through it when needed. But I warn you—this mark works both ways. If you harbor malicious intentions, I can sense it.'

Chen Ji lowered his gaze to his palm, where the demonic rune mark had completely vanished, as if it never existed. A cold smile formed in his heart—such mutual surveillance methods suited him perfectly. Just then, the dream space began to collapse violently, the mist receding like a tide. Ling Yuan's figure also grew increasingly faint, yet his final words clearly echoed in Chen Ji's ears:

dialogue.content: 'By the way, there's one more thing you must know—your sister Chen Nian, she's still alive, trapped within the Holy Sect's Forbidden Grounds. But there's an ancient seal there, one even I cannot breach. If we want to rescue her, we must join forces to unravel that seal.' Ling Yuan's voice grew increasingly distant. 'Remember my words, Chen Ji—you and I share the same origin, and destiny has bound us together!' As the words fell, his figure vanished completely.

text.content: Chen Ji jolted awake from his dream, finding himself still lying in the Tianqing Sect Servants' Quarters bed. Dawn light had just begun to brighten outside the window, and a rooster's crow could be heard faintly. He lowered his gaze to his palm, where the location of that demonic rune mark faintly burned, as if reminding him this was no illusory dream. And deep within his Mental Sea, the Tianji Record Fragment slowly rotated, golden characters appearing line by line:

'The Destined Twins Have Awakened' 'Heaven's Chess Game Enters a New Phase' 'Warning: A Third Force Is Intervening' 'The Existence Behind the Xuanwu Sect Has Detected the Anomaly' Chen Ji stared at these warnings, his mind churning with countless thoughts. Ling Yuan's appearance had disrupted all previous arrangements, the higher existence behind Heaven's Eye had emerged, and finally a lead on his sister Chen Nian had surfaced—Was all this fortune or calamity?

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng's voice rang out again, tinged with worry: "Master, this person's appearance has made the situation far more complex. This old servant knows a thing or two about the secret of the Chen Family's twin separation ten thousand years ago—it was no accident, but deliberately orchestrated. The one who divided the Chen bloodline is very likely connected to the forces behind the Xuanwu Sect today. You must prepare yourself—the chessboard of this game has expanded beyond your imagination."

choice.prompt: Faced with this intricate situation, what should Chen Ji do next?

choices.text: Secretly investigate the Chen Family's history
choices.description: Trace the truth behind the Chen Family twins' separation ten thousand years ago through the Tianji Record, seeking deliberately hidden historical fragments, and gradually uncover the conspiracy behind it.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain key historical truths, possibly discover hidden treasures or secret methods of the Chen Family
choices.risk_hint: Excessive use of the Tianji Record may attract the attention of the Heavenly Eye

dialogue.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, a resolute glint flickering in his eyes: "Since the chessboard has been laid out, then I must see clearly the origins of every piece." He slowly closed his eyes, his divine sense sinking deep into the Tianji Record, urging the fragment to trace the Chen Family's history from ten thousand years ago. In an instant, countless fragments of light flooded into his mind—a pair of twin infants forcibly separated, one wailing, the other wrapped in demonic aura... And at the end of that vision, a blurred figure stood watching it all.

choices.description: Temporarily take no active action, continue to lurk under thetrash (waste) persona, closely observe the movements of all parties including Ling Yuan, the Xuanwu Sect, and the Heavenly Eye, waiting for the optimal moment.
choices.visible_cost: May miss the opportunity to strike first
choices.visible_reward: Not revealing intentions, maintaining the initiative from the shadows
choices.risk_hint: If all parties unite against you, you may fall into a passive situation

dialogue.content: Chen Ji rose, his expression unchanged as he tidied his robes, as if nothing had happened. He pushed open the door, walking toward the well outside the Servants' Quarters in the morning light, calmly drawing water to wash. As he passed a few early-rising disciples, he still kept his head bowed and servile, the perfect picture of atrash (waste). But no one saw, deep in his eyes, that dark gleam was rapidly calculating something.

choices.text: Test the old Sect Master's reaction
choices.description: Ling Yuan is Chen Xuan's previous generation inheritance candidate and knows much about the Chen Family secrets. Visit under the pretense of请教 (seeking guidance) on cultivation, and probe his understanding of the fate twins through indirect means.
choices.visible_reward: May obtain crucial intelligence and judge Ling Yuan's stance
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan is extremely deep and scheming, may反过来 (reverse) probe you instead

dialogue.content: Chen Ji gazed toward the highest peak where the Sect Master resided in the Tianqing Sect, a cold smile forming in his heart. Old fox Ling Yuan—how much does he know about the Chen Family's matters from ten thousand years ago? He decided to visit today under the guise of paying respects, to see what reaction this old fox would have to the mention of "fate twins." Know yourself and your enemy, and you can gain the upper hand in subsequent power plays.

text.content: Just as Chen Ji's thoughts churned, a sudden commotion echoed from the distance. Several Inner Disciples rushed through the Servants' Quarters area with urgent expressions, the leader shouting loudly: "Urgent announcement! The Demonic Path army's vanguard has reached the outer defense line! Commander Ling Xiao has issued a challenge—three days from now, he will personally lead elite forces to attack the city! The sect's high-level officials are urgently gathering all disciples!" The news was like a stone dropped into a calm lake, instantly creating waves.

Chen Ji watched his panicked fellow disciples, a slight smirk playing at the corner of his lips. Fate twins—one commands the Demonic Path, the other is atrash (waste) in the righteous path—the siege battle three days from now will be their first direct confrontation since the dream. And before that, he must uncover more truth. Three days is enough for him to weave a grand net, engulfing all the chess players within it. The Tianji Record Fragment trembled lightly, as if responding to his ambition.

Chen Ji took a deep breath,收敛 (suppressing) the aura of the Tianji Record Fragment to the extreme. He turned and walked toward the gathered crowd, his silhouette stretching into a thin shadow in the morning light. No one knew that this seemingly humble servant disciple was rapidly deducing countless possibilities in his mind. The siege battle three days from now would be the first formal confrontation between the fate twins—and before then, he must seize the initiative, keeping all variables firmly in his grasp. Outside the window, the morning sun rose, the Tianqing Sect shrouded in golden light, yet undercurrents surged beneath the surface.
